module_summary: Synchronous 8-deep valid/ready FIFO: an 8x32 register array with write/read pointers and an occupancy counter that derives ready/valid, plus synchronous flush.

anchors.name: n8_eb3
anchors.why: 8-entry data array written at write pointer on push, read at read pointer.

anchors.name: n12_1bb
anchors.why: Input-side valid; with ready forms the push enable.

anchors.name: n5_c1d
anchors.why: Input-side ready, high while occupancy below depth (not full).

anchors.name: n4_508
anchors.why: Write data stored into array on push.

anchors.name: n15_7b3
anchors.why: Output-side valid, high while occupancy nonzero (not empty).

anchors.name: n0_a37
anchors.why: Output-side ready from consumer; with valid forms the pop enable.

anchors.name: n1_2b9
anchors.why: Read data, array entry at read pointer.

anchors.name: n10_24b
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing array, increments on push, cleared on flush.

anchors.name: n6_59a
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting output entry, increments on pop, cleared on flush.

anchors.name: n7_d82
anchors.why: Occupancy count up on push, down on pop; derives full/empty and count output.

anchors.name: n11_5ef
anchors.why: Synchronous flush clearing both pointers and occupancy count.

anchors.name: n13_74f
anchors.why: Push enable: valid and ready; writes array, bumps write pointer and count.

anchors.name: n9_41c
anchors.why: Pop enable: valid and ready; bumps read pointer, decrements count.

groups.name: FIFO storage
groups.description: 8x32 data array with write-in and read-out data.

groups.name: Pointer and occupancy control
groups.description: Pointers and count updated by push/pop, cleared by flush.

groups.name: Handshake logic
groups.description: Ready from not-full, valid from not-empty.
